headline: Executive order aims to strengthen preferences for American-made products in federally supported infrastructure projects.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to give stronger preference to American-made materials and products in infrastructure projects. Infrastructure includes things like roads, bridges, and water systems. No summary was provided, so the exact rules, products covered, and agency duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that fund or manage infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: They are likely expected to take steps to favor American-made products in the projects they support.

who_it_affects.group: State and local governments and contractors building federally supported infrastructure
who_it_affects.how: They may face more encouragement or requirements to buy American-made materials.

who_it_affects.group: US manufacturers of building materials and products
who_it_affects.how: They may see more demand if infrastructure projects shift toward American-made goods.
They may find it harder to sell to federally supported infrastructure projects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 31, 2019; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they state otherwise.
